_comment: Prompt style for the Pictures panel and tools/gen_art.py. Each picture is: prefix, subject (from the JSON data), framing for its kind, suffix.
prefix: dark fantasy gothic horror illustration, painterly, moody dramatic lighting, rich detail,
negative: text, watermark, signature, logo, lowres, blurry, jpeg artifacts, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers, modern clothing, photo

framing.characters: upper body portrait, looking at the viewer, eye level, shallow depth of field
framing.npcs: upper body portrait, looking at the viewer, eye level, shallow depth of field
framing.monsters: full body, three-quarter view, centered, plain dark background
framing.locations: wide establishing shot, eye level, no people
framing.modules: sweeping panoramic establishing shot, low angle, no people
